_comment: Answer keys set by the user (2026-11-17). Only the user changes these. Never edit them to make a run pass. CLS_MODE in scripts/knobs.env picks relative or absolute CLS.

known.why: Deliberate in prove instances: no Deepgram key is configured, so dictation token minting answers 503.

TEMPORARY (approved 2026-11-17, delegated by the user): pre-existing on main (ca702e5) with the core plugins enabled. rich-code-blocks' relative @import of its fonts CSS resolves against the page URL. A follow-up PR fixes it and removes this entry.

cls.relativeRule: head median of its samples <= highest base sample on the same page + relativeNoise (pages measured once compare their single readings)
cls.why: The user, 2026-11-17. CLS_MODE=absolute (head median < absoluteMax) since the sidebar's opening shift on first load was fixed (docs/specs/polish-first-load.md). Before that fix main scored about 0.27 on every page; the relative rule stays for CLS_MODE=relative. The reloaded session page is still loaded 3 times per side.

axe.rule: no serious or critical violation id on a page that the base commit does not also have on that page
